title: Murder on the Honore Express
summary: A man sitting at the back of the bus is found stabbed at the end of the trip.
method: The killer stabbed the man through the emergency exit door in the back of the bus. The killer taped a random key to the seat of the bus and told the victim that it would lead to a locker with the money.
motive: The victim was the killer's accomplice during a robbery several years ago who wanted his cut of the money. The killer spent all of the money while the victim was in prison.
